name: Bramble & Bee
tagline: A berry patch and apiary where the rows hum all summer long.
imageAlt: A close-up mix of fresh summer berries
description: Bramble & Bee is a u-pick farm in Hood River, OR. Visitors come for Strawberries, Raspberries, Blueberries, and Wildflower honey, best in summer. It follows pollinator-first, no synthetic sprays, and family-run practices. It has been growing since 2008. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
